mock_banner: Demo data: shops, offers and pictures are fictional. This is not real food availability.
sim_push: Simulated notification, no real push service
loc_sheet_title: Where do you want to collect food?
loc_use_gps_s: Location is only used while the app is open.
loc_denied_body: You can still find food: pick a city below. You can allow location later in device settings.
gps_dialog_t: Allow Free To Go to use your location?
gps_dialog_s: We show the nearest free food offers. We never track your location in the background.
walkin_now_note: No reservation – availability uncertain. Status comes from other collectors’ reports.
photo_credit: Photos: Flutter project sample images (BSD licence).
theme_s: The colour theme changes immediately and is kept when you reopen the app.
no_match_body: Try a wider radius or remove filters.
empty_body: Shops usually post surplus in the afternoon. Follow shops and hear about new offers right away.
empty_alerts_s: We tell you when free food appears in your area.
empty_alerts_on_s: You’ll be notified when a new offer is posted.
empty_radius_s: Now {{km}} km. There may be more shops nearby.
participating_s: The heart saves a favourite. The bell sends alerts about new offers.
pick_location_body: Allow location or choose a city to see the nearest free food offers.
walkin_explain: Come during the pickup window. Nothing is held for anyone and it may run out before you arrive.
reserve_explain_t: A reserved bag is held for you
reserve_explain_s: Once confirmed, the shop holds your bag until the end of the pickup window.
directions_toast: Opens directions in your maps app (simulated in demo).
contents_caveat: Bag contents vary. Not every listed food group is necessarily in every bag.
allergen_note: Ask the shop about allergens and ingredients when collecting. Unchecked food groups do not mean a product is allergen-free or vegetarian.
ratings_none: No ratings yet. Ratings only come from verified pickups.
reliability_s: {{ok}} successful / {{f}} shop-caused failures. Separate from food ratings.
no_reserve_needed: No reservation needed. Go during the pickup window.
cta_soldout_why: Turn on the shop’s bell to hear about the next offer.
cta_ended_why: The pickup window is over or the shop closed the offer. Find new offers in Discover.
cta_has_active: You already have an active reservation
cta_has_active_why: Each collector can hold one active reservation at a time. Collect or cancel your current one first.
report_title: Are you there? Share what’s left
report_sub: One tap helps others. Your report is shown as unverified.
report_thanks: Thanks! Others can see your report.
report_yours: You reported: {{r}} · {{a}}. You can update it.
possibly_gone_s: One collector reported {{a}} that everything is gone. The shop hasn’t confirmed this.
review_s: Several collectors reported that everything is gone. The shop has been asked to confirm.
closed_t: All gone – closed by the shop
closed_s: The shop confirmed {{a}} that the food has run out.
expired_s: The giveaway closed automatically because the shop didn’t extend it.
quality_optional_s: Separate from availability. Only counts toward the shop’s average once your pickup is verified.
quality_saved: Quality rating saved, pending pickup verification.
confirm_body: Reserving is free. Please come to collect – repeated no-shows can limit reservations.
checking_s: Making sure a bag is still available.
reserved_body: Collect at {{store}} today {{s}}–{{e}}. Show your pickup code at the counter.
race_body: The last bag was reserved just before you. Turn on the bell to hear about the next offer.
offer_gone_title: This offer is no longer available
offer_gone_body: We checked: the pickup window ended or the offer was closed. Find new offers in Discover.
pickup_code_s: Show this code to shop staff. They confirm the pickup by scanning it.
cancel_confirm_s: The bag is released to others. Cancelling is free.
not_received: I didn’t get my food bag
not_received_s: Tell us why you didn’t get your reserved bag. We’ll look into it.
nr_sent_s: We’ll check with the shop. A verified shop-caused failure affects the shop’s pickup reliability – not its food ratings.
no_pickups_s: When you reserve a free bag, its pickup code and time appear here.
merchant_cancelled_s: Reason: {{r}}. You can reserve another bag right away.
collected_s: Thanks for saving food. How did it go?
rate_s: Four separate scores. Only for verified pickups, published anonymously.
rate_missing: Give stars for all four items.
rating_thanks: Thanks! Your rating appears on the shop page.
safety_s: Use this if food was spoiled or product information was dangerously wrong. This is separate from star ratings.
safety_sent: Report sent to the shop and the Free To Go team (simulated).
safety_urgent: If someone is seriously ill, call 112.
fav_empty_s: Tap the heart on a shop. Use the bell to get alerts about its new offers.
fav_added_bell: Added to favourites. Want alerts about this shop’s new offers?
perm_unknown_s: Your device asks for permission when you turn on your first alert.
perm_denied: Notifications are blocked in device settings
perm_denied_s: Your choices are saved, but alerts won’t arrive until you allow them.
push_dialog_t: “Free To Go” would like to send you notifications
push_dialog_s: Notifications may include alerts and sounds. You can change this in Settings.
n_fav_s: A new offer at any of your favourite shops ({{n}}).
n_bell_s: {{n}} shops. The bell works even if the shop isn’t a favourite.
n_city_s: All shops in the city. You don’t need to be there.
quiet_s: No alerts {{s}}–{{e}}. Alerts wait until morning.
cancel_alert_s: We always tell you if the shop cancels your reservation. Can’t be turned off.
how_alerts_1: You get at most one alert per offer, even if several settings match.
how_alerts_2: We never track your location in the background. Radius is measured from your saved place.
how_alerts_3: Availability is rechecked when you open an alert.
push_new_bags_s: Collect today {{s}}–{{e}}. Reserve before they go!
privacy_body: We collect only what the service needs. Location is never tracked in the background. In the finished app you can download or delete your data here – these actions aren’t active in the demo.
help_body: Free To Go shares shops’ surplus food for free. No payments, no ads. Support isn’t active in the demo.
m_repeat_s: Based on your last post. Just check food groups, quantity and time.
m_mode_reserved_s: Packed surprise bags with a known count.
m_mode_reserved_l1: Collectors reserve for free in the app
m_mode_reserved_l2: You confirm pickups with a QR code
m_mode_walkin_s: Loose goods you can’t count – e.g. a crate of bananas.
m_mode_walkin_l1: First come, first served, no count
m_mode_walkin_l2: A new photo every time is required
m_check_banner: Check before publishing: food groups, quantity and pickup time.
m_bags_hint: Whole numbers only. These bags are held for collectors.
m_groups_hint: Select all that apply. Different bags can contain different groups.
m_groups_walkin_hint: Optional. Helps collectors find the offer.
m_photo_opt: Optional. A photo of today’s food helps most.
m_photo_req: Required: take a new photo of the food on offer now. Old photos can’t be used.
m_what_ph: E.g. a crate of ripe bananas
m_expiry_note: The giveaway closes automatically after 60 min unless you extend it by 30 min. (Pilot proposal.)
m_need_groups: Select at least one food group.
m_need_photo: Take a new photo before publishing.
m_need_time: End time must be after the start time and in the future.
m_auto_notify: Followers are notified automatically – nothing else to do.
m_camera_s: Camera only: old gallery photos can’t be chosen.
m_camera_sim: Simulated camera – demo uses an illustration
m_none_active_s: Post surplus in seconds – your last post works as a draft.
m_scan_s: In the demo pick a code from the list – the real app reads it with the camera.
m_edit_min: The count can’t go below the bags already reserved ({{n}}).
m_stopped: New reservations stopped. Existing ones remain valid.
m_cancel_s: Collectors are notified immediately. Shop-caused cancellations affect your pickup reliability.
m_all_gone_s: Closes the giveaway for everyone now.
m_closed_toast: Giveaway closed. Collectors see: all gone.
m_extend_confirm: I confirm there is still food left.
m_still_food_toast: Marked: food remains. Shown to collectors as confirmed by the shop.
m_store_public_s: Collector ratings and reports can’t be edited.
log.walkin_review: {{store}}: under review, shop asked to confirm
demo_s: The app uses demo data stored on this device. No backend is connected yet. Use these to try events on a single phone.
demo_photo_s: The camera isn’t available here. The demo photo is marked as simulated.
camera_denied: Camera access is blocked. Allow the camera in device settings.
scan_invalid: Code not found for this offer.
scan_camera: Point the camera at the collector’s QR code.
qr_real: The shop scans this code when you collect.
gps_none: No demo shops near you. Choose Tampere to see example offers.
notif_sent_native: An alert was sent to this device.
pickups_rate_hint: Rate a collected bag with four star rows.
